0022600207.text: The Dallas Mavericks (6-4, 4-2 at home, winners of two straight) host the Indiana Pacers (3-7, 0-5 at home, coming off a loss) in the Mavericks' 11th game of the season, with Dallas sitting 4th in the Southwest, 2 games back, and Indiana 3rd in the Central, 3.5 games back. Dallas leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 121-105 win in Indianapolis on October 23, and the Mavericks also won both meetings in 2025-26. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Morez Johnson Jr. (leg), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain).
